# iximiuz-labs_play_port (Resource)

Exposes an HTTP port on a play machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iximiuz-labs_play_port" "web" {
  play_id = iximiuz-labs_play.example.id
  machine = "docker-01"
  number  = 8080
  access  = "public"
  tls     = true
}

output "port_url" {
  value = iximiuz-labs_play_port.web.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `machine` (String) The machine name to expose the port on.
- `number` (Number) The port number to expose.
- `play_id` (String) The play ID to expose the port on.

### Optional

- `access` (String) Access mode for the port: `private` or `public`.
- `host_rewrite` (String) Host header rewrite value.
- `path_rewrite` (String) Path prefix rewrite value.
- `tls` (Boolean) Whether to enable TLS for the exposed port.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) The hostname assigned to the exposed port.
- `id` (String) Server-generated port ID.
- `url` (String) The full URL of the exposed port.
